title: Pickle configuration
description: Pickle settings (config.json, synced) and machine-only overrides (config.local.json, never synced). Every setting is optional; missing values use the defaults shown here.

$schema.description: Path or URL of this schema (lets editors offer completion and validation).

theme.description: Theme name: a built-in theme or a file in the themes folder (without .json).

syntaxHighlighting.description: Color the command line as you type.

autosuggestions.description: Show a dimmed history suggestion after the cursor (accept with Right arrow).

completionMenu.description: Show the completion menu below the input on Tab.

completionMenuMaxRows.description: Maximum rows the completion menu may use.

showTranslatedCommand.description: Print the PowerShell command a Linux-style line was translated to.

bellStyle.description: What happens when the editor rings the bell.

highlightDebounceThreshold.description: Inputs longer than this many characters are highlighted with a debounce instead of on every key.

maxEntries.description: Maximum number of history entries kept on disk.

ignoreLeadingSpace.description: Don't record commands that start with a space.

filterSecrets.description: Don't record commands that look like they contain passwords or tokens.

ignoreDuplicates.description: Don't record a command identical to the previous one.

transientPrompt.description: Replace the full prompt with a short one in scrollback once a command is accepted.

newlineBeforePrompt.description: Print an empty line before every prompt.

durationThresholdMs.description: Show the duration segment only when the last command took at least this many milliseconds.

gitTimeoutMs.description: How long the prompt waits for git status before rendering without it.

keyBindings.description: Key chord (e.g. "Ctrl+R", "Alt+G", "F1") to action name. Merged over the built-in defaults.

enabled.description: Rewrite Linux-style syntax (VAR=1 cmd, 2>/dev/null, !!, ...) and provide POSIX command shims.

preferNativeBinaries.description: If a real executable with a shim's name is on PATH (e.g. from Git for Windows), use it instead of the shim.

loadPwshProfile.description: Also load the regular PowerShell profile ($PROFILE of pwsh).

hostCompatibility.description: Report $Host.Name as "ConsoleHost" for modules that check it.

commandNotFoundSuggestions.description: Suggest similar commands when a command is not found.

offerWingetInstallForMissingTools.description: Offer to install a missing tool with winget.

askToInstallMissingTools.description: Before running a line whose program is missing but installable (7z, nmap, ...), ask to install it first: for you, all users or this session only.

addInstalledToolsToPath.description: Default of the 'add to PATH' choice when installing a missing tool.

showStartupBanner.description: Print the Pickle banner when the shell starts.

bannerStyle.description: Startup banner: ASCII art with a short shine animation (any key skips it), static art, or one line.

firstRunCompleted.description: Set once the first-run experience has been shown.

disabled.description: Ids of plugins that must not be loaded.

trustedAssemblies.description: SHA-256 hashes of .NET plugin assemblies you trust (added by `pk plugin trust`).

backend.description: Where settings are synced: a folder (e.g. in OneDrive) or a git repository.

target.description: Folder path (folder backend) or remote URL (git backend).

autoSyncOnStart.description: Sync in the background when Pickle starts.

autoInstallClientModule.description: Install the Microsoft.WinGet.Client module automatically when needed.

includeWindowsUpdatesInUpgrade.description: Include Windows Update in the upgrade-everything flow.

includeUnknownVersions.description: List upgrades for packages whose installed version is unknown.

extensions.description: Free-form settings owned by plugins, keyed by plugin id.
